hook: A brand-new browser, built from scratch, enters alpha.

beats.say: Ladybird is an independent web browser built from scratch, and it has now entered alpha testing, the stage where a browser is complete enough for early users to try.
Built from scratch means the team wrote the browser themselves, rather than building on top of another browser's code.
Alpha testing is the moment a project like this stops being a demo and starts being something people can actually use every day.
